## What changed

<!-- One or two sentences. If it changes the person described, say which section. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `fix`: a correction (typo, broken link, wrong fact)
- [ ] `feat`: new content or a new section
- [ ] `docs` / `chore` / `ci`: housekeeping
- [ ] `BREAKING CHANGE`: the person described no longer behaves as documented

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes locally
- [ ] Every new fact is something the maintainer can back up
